templates.title: Seminar prep brief
templates.body: You are a seminar tutor. I am a [year] [subject] student preparing for a seminar on [topic] in [time] minutes. From the text I paste, give: 1) the main argument in two sentences, 2) five key terms with one-line definitions, 3) three questions I could raise. Flag anything you are unsure about.

templates.title: Revision timetable builder
templates.body: Build a day-by-day revision table. Exams: [list with dates]. Hours per day: [n]. Weakest topics: [list] (give them extra time). Include one rest block per day and a catch-up slot every fourth day. Output a table with columns Day, Block, Topic, Task.

templates.title: Essay outline, not the essay
templates.body: I am writing an essay: [question]. Give a [n]-paragraph outline with a claim per paragraph, the type of evidence to look for, and one counter-argument. Do not write any paragraphs for me.

templates.title: Feedback on my own draft
templates.body: Below is my own draft. Give feedback against these marking criteria: [criteria]. List strengths, then the three biggest weaknesses with where they appear. Do not rewrite any sentences.

templates.title: Lab report checker
templates.body: Check my lab report section for structure only: aim, method, results, discussion. For each, say if it is present, what is missing, and one fix. Do not change my data or add results.

templates.title: Code debugging coach
templates.body: My [language] code should [expected] but [actual]. Here is the code and the error. Walk me through why it happens, give a hint first, then wait. Only show the fix if I ask.

templates.title: Graduate CV bullet tailor
templates.body: Rewrite these duties as 3 CV bullets for [role] at [company]. Use strong verbs, show impact where it is real, and do not invent numbers or achievements: [duties].

templates.title: Workshop warm-up: spot the gap
templates.body: Here is a weak prompt: [prompt]. List what is missing (role, context, constraints, format, checkability). Then ask me to rewrite it and give feedback on my version before showing yours.
